title: Portuguese Bean Stew
description: A hearty, comforting stew made with cannellini beans, kissed with Portuguese flavors. This gluten-free recipe is perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the sliced chorizo and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the stew beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chicken broth, cannellini beans, and salt and pepper to taste.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
